claims.text: Many reviewers report the oil helps clear or fade acne scars and blemishes.
Several reviewers say it effectively soothes skin conditions like eczema, rosacea, and scalp psoriasis.
A common complaint is that the oil arrived black, gritty, or rancid, which some reviewers consider spoiled or oxidized.
Reviewers frequently mention a strong, distinctive scent (licorice, peppery, earthy, or planty) that some find offensive and others do not mind.
Some reviewers note the consistency is thinner and more liquid than other oils.
